decisions.reason: It remains a low-cost, agency-relevant compliance add-on with some early validation, so keeping the option open is preferable while demand and cross-selling potential continue to become clearer.
As the firm's flagship platform and core strategic extension of its hosting business, it is too central to the firm's direction to abandon absent clear negative evidence.
It is a young but close-to-core security extension that likely costs little to maintain relative to its customer value, so the firm should keep it on the market until its uptake is better revealed.
